description: I spend half my time explaining AI to humans, and the other half explaining humans to code. I work with companies to apply technology where it actually provides value. Most of the time it’s AI (I’m known for it lol). So far that’s included subtitling for 1,000+ hours of video across 10 languages, an AEMO energy trading system, and a POS and kiosk platform.

imageAlt: Software development work at Math Song
description: Here I built automations and web apps that solve real problems. Mostly Django, with payment integrations handling $200K+ a month. I also looked after the GCP infrastructure, Docker, Terraform, and deployment pipelines.

imageAlt: Battery research at Fair Dinkum Systems
description: One of the more exciting times of my career. Plenty of late nights and overnighters developing ML for battery health and lifecycle prediction. Ever heard of anyone trying to get a Vision Transformer to work with spectrograms of large time series? :D Slightly dumb, I know, but that’s half the fun. I also got to dive into the supply chain and talk to a lot of interesting people.

Large-scale remote sensing (NDA). I developed end-to-end ML for environmental monitoring serving banking and retail companies. This included satellite data pipelines, emissions modelling, and adapting land-classification models to Australian conditions.

My first and most loved role. Here I built high-altitude balloon gondola systems for real-time computer vision on board, for environmental monitoring and early detection. The work included hardware, firmware, MLOps with AWS, fieldwork, and some physics-based software. Basically what you’d expect from a startup haha.
